text:
noah-ps: ResellerAlly needs a fast pilot: embeddable help widget that calls Redwood for succinct answers + embeddings. Procurement asked for architecture, pricing, and a one-page SOW by EOD. cc @maya-se @lloyd-legal.

maya-se: Recommend partner-proxy pattern for pilot (partner backend signs requests to Redwood). Keeps keys server-side, easier entitlements. Dedicated only if they want BYOK/physical isolation.

raj-fe: Confirmed: do not put our key in the browser. I'll prepare a tiny widget that posts to /partner/api/chat which proxies to us. Will include CORS and retry logic.

emily-partner: Pilot scope: 4 pilot tenants, ~30 MAU each, mostly faq search + short Q&A. Procurement likes flat pilot fee + capped usage. Need SOC2 + encryption answers for their security form today.

noah-ps: Suggested commercial: $1,000 pilot fee + 2M tokens at $0.001/token, 6 SE hours. Approve?

maya-se: Pricing is reasonable. Recommend 8 SE hours. Also we should include a simple fallback model policy in doc so demo stays responsive.

lloyd-legal: I can draft a brief SOW and reseller note. Need to know if they will resell or just embed. Also will add data retention defaults and termination.

sec-bot: Security snapshot: SOC2 Type II available (https://redwood.company/security), TLS1.2+, at-rest AES-256. BYOK for Private/Dedicated. For questionnaire, email security@redwood.ai with subject 'ResellerAlly pilot'.

emily-partner: Theyll not store PII in demo; ask about default logs retention and ability to redact.

maya-se: Hosted logs default 30 days. For pilot we can shorten to 7 days if needed. We'll add retention clause to SOW.

raj-fe: I'll push example repo with proxy README and healthcheck this afternoon.

noah-ps: Next: @maya-se architecture diagram + fallback runbook, @raj-fe demo repo link, @lloyd-legal SOW draft, security team to reply to questionnaire. I'll send pricing to procurement now.

emily-partner: Decision meeting in 48h; deliverables before then = go/no-go. Thanks.
